name: color-palette
title: Cloudlet Color Palette
description: One to four colors in a row, each a Cloudlet color picker: an add button that opens the new color's picker at once, removal with Delete or the pointer's ×, one Tab stop with arrow keys, springs that grow and fold the swatches. Installs the color picker with it.
docs: Import ColorPalette from components/ui/color-palette/color-palette; it imports its own color-palette.css and the color picker it is built on. colors/onChange take and return an array of hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() strings in `format`; `max` caps the count (4 by default), `name` adds one hidden input per color, `labels.picker` translates the pickers. Styles read the shadcn tokens --background, --foreground, --border and --ring. color-palette-agent.ts (useColorPaletteAgent) connects the palette to the Cloudlet agent bridge and costs nothing until you import it.
